title: AstroGrass: a curated resource for the Brachypodium distachyon ISS transcriptome study OSD-375 and gravitropism candidate genes
description: A curated resource around NASA OSDR study OSD-375 (APEX-06), in which Brachypodium distachyon accessions Bd21, Bd21-3 and Gaz8 were grown on the International Space Station. It contains the OSD-375 sample design parsed from the OSDR metadata, a catalogue of five grass spaceflight and related omics studies checked against their source records, a list of 29 gravitropism candidate genes with UniProt-checked Arabidopsis anchors, and root time-lapse videos. No new analysis of the OSD-375 data is included; earlier GWAS, re-analysis and cross-species results were withdrawn on 2026-10-14.
